name: Pasta with Chickpeas
dish: Short pasta for two in a garlicky, part-mashed chickpea sauce with rosemary and a little cayenne, loosened with pasta water, grated hard cheese on top.

ingredients: good-quality pasta (e.g., fusilli lungi, penne, or orecchiette)

stages.do: at same time: good glug of oil, garlic, gentle cook
chickpeas in, stir; mash roughly half with spoon back
one ladle of pasta water in; simmer
drain pasta, toss in chickpea pan

notes: Salt for water not in list. Cayenne amount is "tip of a knife" = tiny pinch. Take the ladle of water before draining.
